  > Implemented PSI-013 in a NEW migration (20260925094732_access_token_hook.sql) rather than editing the already-stamped M1 file. Added public.claims_for_user(uuid) (SQL, stable, security definer, search_path='') that resolves effective_role_ids into app_roles, group memberships into app_groups, and role_permissions into app_permissions, and public.custom_access_token_hook(jsonb) (plpgsql) that jsonb_set's the claims onto the event. Grants: only supabase_auth_admin may execute either; authenticated and anon are revoked, plus grant usage on schema public to supabase_auth_admin. Enabled [auth.hook.custom_access_token] in supabase/config.toml -> pg-functions://postgres/public/custom_access_token_hook. First db reset hit a typo (revoke ... to) which I fixed to grant ... to per m1-rbac.md:370. Verified live via two scripts: psi013-verify.sql (admin claims carry app_roles/admin, app_groups/all-members, all 15 app_permissions; authenticated/anon cannot execute either function, supabase_auth_admin can; hook merges claims into event) and psi013-group-inherit.sql (transactional, rolled back: member1 with NO direct role but in a group that holds a role resolves app_roles=['test-sr'] and app_permissions=['mail.send'] through the group edge).
